acceptance_criteria: php.generic-status-envelopes appears in the registry and in docs/rules.md.
A new test asserts the rule fires on a generic envelope and stays quiet on a lone ok key and on a domain-named payload.
The php.structure fact provider schema version is bumped so stale scan caches cannot serve a missing file.statusEnvelopes fact.
composer run test, composer run analyse and composer run lint stay green.
behavior_anchors: PHP source file under scan -> slop-scan finding list (rule id, evidence, score)
existing .slop-scan.cache.json -> re-parsed facts after the provider schema bump
goal: Port the upstream api.generic-status-envelopes check to a deterministic PHP rule php.generic-status-envelopes that flags associative array literals pairing a boolean success/ok/status key with a generic payload key.
non_goals: Do not change scoring or evidence for any existing rule.
Do not port the remaining upstream checks in this task; they stay on the board as SLOP-2..SLOP-6.
